records.title: HoloMotion-1 Technical Report
records.reason: Humanoid motion tracking combines sparse MoE and KV-cache inference to meet real-time constraints, with the report claiming up to 11x inference and 22x training efficiency. It is robotic control rather than LLM serving; assess whether cache/routing design transfers.

records.title: Rethinking Language Model Scaling under Transferable Hypersphere Optimization
records.reason: Transferable hypersphere optimization studies language-model scaling and optimizer/training transfer; the full text has no inference or serving evaluation despite quantization/MoE citation links.

records.title: RayRoPE: Projective Ray Positional Encoding for Multi-view Attention
records.reason: RayRoPE introduces projective ray positional encoding for multi-view vision attention. The paper addresses geometric representation, not LLM context extension or inference cost.

records.title: MoEGAD: A Mixture-of-Experts Framework With Pseudo-Anomaly Generation for Graph-Level Anomaly Detection
records.reason: PubMed primary bibliographic record/abstract identifies MoEGAD as graph-level anomaly detection with pseudo-anomalous graph generation. It is a graph-detection application, not LLM inference/serving; the MoE citation link is terminology-level only.

records.title: Transolver is a Linear Transformer: Revisiting Physics-Attention through the Lens of Linear Attention
records.reason: LinearNO reframes physics-attention as linear attention and reports 36.2% lower compute and 40% fewer parameters on PDE benchmarks. This is a non-LLM scientific operator; the linear-attention mechanism is a possible architecture lead only.
